Innorack Tall IVC Rat

A highly controlled clean environment at each cage level

It’s portable, ergonomic, and easy to configure top-of-the-line ventilated rat housing system designed to house Innovive disposable IVC cages. The rack is powered by patented transversal airflow and delivers dual HEPA-filtered air into each recyclable cage. Controlled airflow allows positive and negative modes of operation. It comes with a dynamic digital controller and provides a high-quality environment for your animals.

Contact Sales

Innorack Tall IVC Rat Features

  • Dynamic Digital Controller
  • • Dynamically maintains settings on both supply and exhaust blowers.
  • • Quick-look color display for easy status monitoring.
  • Ergonomic Design
  • • Lightweight rack & blowers.
  • • Full cage visibility.
  • Easy Cleaning and Maintenance
  • • Continuous shelf design and smooth beveled surface allow for easy cleaning.
  • • Quick-disconnect blowers.
  • • Autoclavable Innorack available upon request.
  • Low-Vibration Rack Operations
  • • A low-vibration ventilation system creates a stress-free animal environment, contributing to animal welfare.

Innocage® Tall IVC Rat

The Innocage® Tall IVC Rat system offers the benefit of more headroom, providing 9" (22.9cm). The Tall Rat caging uses a Tall Rat cage lid, stainless steel wire bar, an 850 mL water bottle, and a universal rat cage bottom. View Caging
